name: Jest of the Miracle Court
body:
School: Transmutation; Level: jester 5

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Close (75 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target: One or two creatures

Duration: 1 round

Saving Throw: none; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target is unable to take a 5-foot step until the end of your next turn.
